acceptanceCriteria: A receipt written for a runner-killed run (timeout or SIGKILL, exitCode -1) decodes, or is refused with a specific named code, rather than a generic malformed-receipt refusal.
A regression test covers a timed-out run's receipt round trip.
The test-runner spec states the exitCode domain for killed runs.
body:
Found by the V1-0597/0613 SwiftPM lane on 2026-10-08 (Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, branch claude/v1-0597-0613-swiftpm).

Observed: when the runner kills a run (PROCESS_TIMEOUT), the receipt records exitCode -1. The receipt decoder refuses that receipt; it fails closed, so no wrong result is accepted, but a timed-out run's receipt cannot be read back.

Expected: a killed run's receipt round-trips, or the refusal names the killed-run case.

Candidate site (suspected, not confirmed as the decoder path): internal/testrunner/validate.go:118 rejects ExitCode < 0.

Reproduction: run a SwiftPM fixture with a 30 s timeout that hangs (lane evidence /private/tmp/claude-501/swiftpm-td/live2/), then decode the receipt.
